summary: Verified automatic favicon feature in PublicLayout.jsx. After uploading a logo via CMS > Pengaturan Situs and saving, document.head on the public site contains exactly one link[data-auto-favicon='icon'] and one link[data-auto-favicon='apple-touch-icon'], both with href equal to the brand-logo-img src and both URLs return HTTP 200. Favicon persists (no duplication) when navigating between /, /fleet, /contact. After clearing the logo via ss-logo_url-clear + Simpan, both data-auto-favicon links are removed from document.head on reload of /. Logo was cleared at the end as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: Favicon effect in PublicLayout.jsx returns early (return undefined) when href is empty, so previously injected favicon links are NOT removed when the user clears the logo WITHOUT a full page reload (SPA session). In practice this works because clearing logo requires server round-trip and users reload; but a cleaner approach would be to always remove existing link[data-auto-favicon] elements first, then re-add if href is truthy.
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/testlogo.png (200x200 red PNG) via PIL. Uploaded as media, then cleared at end so logo_url is empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Favicon auto-update feature works correctly. Note: after modifying PublicLayout.jsx the CRA dev server bundle may be stale; a fresh test session initially saw 0 favicon links until `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. After restart the feature worked end-to-end: upload -> favicon appears, navigate -> single instance persists, clear -> favicon removed. CMS Site Settings is reached via /app/cms then click data-testid='content-tab-site' (not /app/cms/site-settings).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bug. Initial dev-bundle staleness resolved by restarting the frontend supervisor process.
